core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Ghadia corresponds to the Arabic form غادية (Arabic root غ د و (gh-d-w)). Its core sense is journey, travel. Ghadia corresponds to Arabic غادية (Ghādiya), the feminine active participle of the root غ د و (gh-d-w) — 'one who goes out in the morning; a morning cloud, a traveller'. The source gloss 'journey, travel' reflects that sense; the form is a real word but its currency as a personal name is limited.
